**Natural Language Processing (NLP)** is a branch of AI that enables computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language. 🧠

Key NLP techniques I use include:
• **Tokenization** — splitting text into words
• **TF-IDF** — measuring word importance
• **Cosine Similarity** — comparing query meaning
• **Intent Classification** — understanding what you want
• **Entity Extraction** — identifying names, dates, numbers

NLP (Natural Language Processing) is the AI technology that allows me to understand your messages! It involves:
1. Breaking text into tokens
2. Removing unnecessary words (stopwords)
3. Vectorizing text mathematically
4. Matching your intent using similarity algorithms

Cool, right? 🤖

**Artificial Intelligence (AI)** is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines! 🤖

AI encompasses:
• **Machine Learning** — learning from data
• **Deep Learning** — neural networks
• **NLP** — understanding language
• **Computer Vision** — seeing images
• **Robotics** — physical automation

I'm a practical example of AI applied to natural language interaction!

AI (Artificial Intelligence) refers to systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, like understanding language, recognizing patterns, making decisions, and learning from experience. I'm powered by AI to chat with you intelligently! 🧠

Here's my technology stack! ⚙️

**Frontend:**
• React.js (Vite)
• Vanilla CSS with Glassmorphism

**Backend:**
• Node.js + Express.js
• Express-session for context

**NLP Engine:**
• Custom TF-IDF Vectorizer
• Cosine Similarity Algorithm
• Intent Classification
• Entity Extraction

**AI Fallback:**
• OpenRouter.ai (Llama/Mistral LLM)

**External APIs:**
• Open-Meteo (weather)
• Wikipedia REST API
